WITH step1 AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.player_id,
        p.bats,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM player_award pa
    JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY pa.player_id, p.bats
),
step2 AS (
    SELECT 
        bats,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM step1
    GROUP BY bats
),
step3 AS (
    SELECT SUM(cnt) as total
    FROM step2
),
step4 AS (
    SELECT 
        s2.bats,
        s2.cnt,
        CAST(s2.cnt AS REAL) / s3.total as ratio
    FROM step2 s2
    CROSS JOIN step3 s3
    WHERE s3.total IS NOT NULL
),
step5 AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio
    FROM step4
)
SELECT 
    s4.bats,
    s4.cnt,
    s4.ratio,
    s4.ratio - s5.avg_ratio as diff
FROM step4 s4
CROSS JOIN step5 s5
WHERE s5.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND s4.ratio > s5.avg_ratio
ORDER BY s4.bats
